decisions.reason: The source changes the visual style of the three characters, not the style or shot-to-shot continuity requirements for set images.
The existing rule to prevent artistic-style drift remains valid unchanged; the character-specific target aesthetic is already owned by the source Requirement.
Refining character aesthetics does not change the resolution, quality standard, or generation policy for set images.
Applying a rougher graffiti aesthetic to the characters does not alter the CC1 shot progression, image-pair structure, or framing ambiguity.
The requested character-style refinement does not change the requirement to restore character shadows while preserving other image elements.
Q's revised aesthetic does not alter which bridges must be retained or removed in the affected Q frames.
